# v1.1.0-dev.105: Virtual Windows of their own

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.104`.

## Virtual Windows have their own page

Virtual windows no longer live inside a profile. The new Virtual Windows
button in the sidebar lists every one you've made. From there you can make
a new one, rename it, open it, delete it, and choose who uses it: every
profile, or the ones you tick.

A profile's Virtual Windows tab is now a picker. Tick the ones that profile
should load. You can still make a new one from there, and it starts out
ticked for that profile.

The first time this version starts, it moves the virtual windows already
in your profiles onto the new list, each still used by the profile it came
from. It takes a version of each profile first, so there's a way back.

## Rearrange docked windows from the app

Each virtual window on the page shows a map of its panes. Drag a window onto
another to swap them. Drag it onto an edge to give it a new pane on that
side. If that virtual window is open, the real windows move right away.

## Explorer folders and consoles come back

File Explorer folders, PowerShell, pwsh and Command Prompt windows usually
don't survive a restart. When a profile loads and one of them is missing,
WLM now starts it again. Explorer reopens the same folder, and a console
opens in the folder it was working in. This is on by default for those
windows, and the window editor has a box to switch it off for one.

WLM records the folder when you save a profile or dock the window. It only
ever starts Explorer, PowerShell, pwsh or Command Prompt by name, and only
for a folder that still exists.

## Docking fixes

- The drop guide now always shows while you drag a window over a container
  that already has windows docked in it. It's drawn on its own layer above
  them, where before a docked window could cover it.
- With the title bar hidden, a small tab stays above the docked windows. It
  gets the title bar and the panel back, where before a docked window could
  cover the way back.

## Automatic Load waits for your game

An automatic Load on a display change or at launch now waits while you're
in a full-screen game or presentation, and runs once you're out.

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53 and later. Otherwise unzip and run.
